abstract: A novel case is reported in which an S2 nerve root malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor was diagnosed approximately 8 years after treatment for Stage I testicular seminoma. This patient underwent right orchiectomy and subsequent irradiation therapy to the periaortic region, including the sacrum. Postoperative radiation therapy likely played a role in the development of this second malignancy.
abstract_ja: 病期I(Stage I)の精巣セミノーマに対する治療から約8年後に、S2神経根の悪性末梢神経鞘腫瘍が診断された症例を報告する。患者は右精巣摘除術を受け、その後、仙骨を含む大動脈周囲領域への放射線療法を受けた。術後の放射線療法が、この二次性悪性腫瘍の発生に関与した可能性が高い。
